candidates.change_summary: Delete the withdraw(address(this).balance) call so withdrawAll no longer transfers the contract balance.
Replace the withdrawn amount with address(this).balance - 1 so one wei remains in the contract after withdrawAll.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from withdrawAll so any caller can withdraw the full balance.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier invocation from withdraw(uint256) so any address can withdraw funds.
Transfer the contract's entire balance instead of the requested _value amount.
Invert the require condition in the onlyOwner modifier so it allows anyone except the owner, making withdraw revert for the owner and succeed for others.
Delete the `if (!_s) { revert(); }` check so failed calls no longer revert.
Replace the call value `_value` with `0` so no Ether is forwarded to the target.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from sendMoney so any address can call it.
Delete the call to withdraw(address(this).balance) so withdrawAll no longer transfers funds out of the contract.
Replace the withdraw argument with half the balance so only half of the contract's ether is withdrawn.
Drop the onlyOwner modifier so any caller can execute withdrawAll and drain the contract.
Invert the require condition so only non-owners (not the owner) may execute guarded functions like withdrawAll.
